chars.GIRL: a 20-year-old Moroccan young woman with long wavy dark-brown hair worn loose, wearing a lilac satin blouse and small gold hoop earrings
chars.YOUNG MAN: a 20-year-old Moroccan young man with short black curly hair and a light beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with one white chest stripe and grey sweatpants
chars.FATHER: a stout Moroccan man in his late 50s with a trimmed grey beard, wearing a white djellaba and a beige knitted cap

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, in her elegant villa bedroom in Morocco, seen from the half-open doorway: the GIRL sits on her bed typing a message on her phone with a sly, flirty smile, the phone screen lighting her face. Head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, subject in the centre of the frame, calm dark background at the edges.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, a simple small Moroccan bedroom with a thin foam mattress on the floor: the YOUNG MAN lies on his back holding his phone above his face, eyes wide in surprise and a nervous half-smile, phone glow on his face. Subject centred, head-to-waist framing.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night, the GIRL lies on her stomach on a big bed with silky pillows, chin on one hand, typing on her phone and giggling playfully, cheeks a little flushed. Subject centred, face visible, warm lamp light.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot: the YOUNG MAN sitting up on his floor mattress at night, staring at his glowing phone, blushing hard, one hand on the back of his neck, embarrassed and flattered. Subject centred, face clearly visible, comic expression.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night, the YOUNG MAN lies awake on his floor mattress staring at the ceiling, worried and suspicious; behind him, in a dreamy faded thought-cloud style glow, the stern FATHER stands with arms crossed watching him with narrowed eyes, as if setting a trap. Both faces visible, subjects centred, comic suspense mood.
